OpenUI Forge 0.1.0 — Initial Release

- Introduces OpenUI Forge for building generative UI apps with any LLM provider and backend language.
- Auto-activates on mentions of "openui," "generative ui," or related triggers.
- Supports multiple frameworks: React (primary), Vue 3, and Svelte 5 via framework-agnostic core.
- Provides CLI and smart commands: analyze project status, scaffold setup, add components, and backend integration.
- Explains best practices for component schemas and library design to ensure optimal LLM-UI generation.
- Includes architecture overview and detailed workflow for rapid, production-grade AI UI projects.
